purpose: Additive owner-authorized Gemini-on-Steel connection adapter; exact-domain bounds, private auth boundary and durable no-blind-retry journal
runtime_requirements: Existing Steel account/project and eligible credits
Owner completes Google login on remote session if required

input_contract.policy: external task/worker/owner/callback/expiry, fresh eligible resource; one session <=15min and one probe submission
input_contract.lease: Fresh per-invocation local adapter ACK before PLAN; not model ACK

output_contract.idempotency: SQLite WAL/FULL intent reservation before mutation; pending/unknown never automatically resubmitted
output_contract.secrets: Viewer/debug/CDP URLs only in private external state, never evidence/release

authentication_requirements: Google remote login if required; human credentials/OTP/CAPTCHA entry direct
Persistent auth storage requires explicit owner approval and separate validated implementation
known_limits: Prototype scoped to synthetic connection test, no general externalaction rights
No profile persistence or Chrome cookie import
Google login/account/remote-browser restrictions remain external gates
New Gemini DOM selectors not LIVE PASS until actual result
Legacy shared gateway and Chrome remain unchanged
No unattended native chat wakeup or global promotion

test_status.LOCAL_FUNCTION_PASS: See independent peer and current TEST-RESULT
test_status.INTEGRATED_PASS: UNVERIFIED; callbacks and acceptance require separate actual receipts
